name: KNB Scholarship (Kemitraan Negara Berkembang / Developing Countries Partnership)
host: Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Technology, Indonesia
amount: check official page (full scholarship at one of 34 host universities)
dlText: ~7 Mar 2027 (estimated from the 2025 cycle, 17 Feb–7 Mar; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Nationals of developing countries partnered with Indonesia; check the current guidelines for the country list.

fields: Any field offered by the 34 KNB host universities
note: Indonesian government scholarship for bachelor's, master's and doctoral study at 34 host universities. The 2027 call isn't published yet: the 2025 window ran 17 Feb–7 Mar with results on 13 June. Watch the official portal.

name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships
host: VLIR-UOS (Flemish universities)
amount: Tuition, travel, insurance, board and lodging for the full programme
dlText: 28 Feb 2027 general deadline; some programmes close earlier (e.g. Food Technology 1 Feb 2027); time not stated
tags: Must reside in an eligible country
fields: 12 development-relevant master's programmes (food technology, governance and development, human settlements, sustainable development and more)
note: Full scholarships for 12 English-taught master's programmes at Flemish universities, starting September 2027. You must live in an eligible country when you apply, though not necessarily your country of nationality. The call page also says Mali was recently added, so check if that matters to you. Apply to each programme by its own deadline.

name: ARES International Training Scholarships (Formations internationales)
host: ARES (Académie de recherche et d'enseignement supérieur, Wallonia-Brussels Federation)
amount: check official page
dlText: 18 Sep 2026, 12:00 Belgian time (2027-28 call, closed)
tags: Permanent resident of an ARES partner country

eligibility.note: Permanent residents of one of the 18 ARES partner countries in the Global South; see the eligibility checker on the ARES page.

fields: Development-related specialisation master's, bachelor's and 6-month professional courses at French-speaking Belgian institutions
note: Scholarships for a one-year specialisation master's, a bachelor's or a six-month professional course in the Wallonia-Brussels Federation. The 2027-28 call closed on 18 Sep 2026 and the next call is expected in August 2027.

name: Fundación Carolina Postgraduate Scholarships
host: Fundación Carolina (Spanish Cooperation)
amount: Varies by programme (see each programme's ficha técnica)
dlText: ~2 Mar 2027 for master's (estimated from 2026 cycle, 12 Jan–2 Mar); doctoral ~9 Apr; time not stated

eligibility.note: Mainly nationals of Latin American (Ibero-American community) countries; requirements vary by programme.

fields: Any (228 postgraduate programmes in the 2026-27 call)
note: An annual call of about 736 grants, 228 of them postgraduate, for study in Spain. In 2026 the postgraduate window ran 12 Jan–2 Mar and doctoral and short stays closed on 9 Apr. Funding and conditions differ by programme.

name: JICA SDGs Global Leader Program (Long-term Training)
host: Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
amount: check official page
dlText: Set by the JICA office in your country (often Sep–Oct the year before)

eligibility.note: Nationals of JICA partner countries, usually government officials or university staff; set by each country's JICA office.

fields: Any field relevant to the SDGs, at partner Japanese universities
note: A JICA long-term training track for mid-career officials and academics: a master's or PhD in Japan, sometimes after about six months as a research student. Each country's JICA office publishes its own call (in the Philippines, forms are issued Sep–Oct for the following September's start).

name: Chinese Government Scholarship – Chinese University Program (Type B)
host: China Scholarship Council via designated Chinese universities
amount: Check official page (coverage depends on the scholarship type; confirm with the university)
dlText: Set by each university (usually early 2027)
fields: Any field at designated universities
note: Designated Chinese universities choose graduate scholarship candidates directly. Apply on the CSC portal under Program Category B with the university's agency number. Each university sets its own deadline, usually early in the year, and CSC confirms awardees by about July.

name: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students (MAECI)
host: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI)
amount: Monthly allowance (check the call for the current amount)
dlText: ~26 Mar 2027, 14:00 Italian time (estimated from 2026 cycle)
tags: Apply via Study in Italy portal

eligibility.note: Citizens of the countries in the call's list of eligible countries, plus Italians residing abroad (IRE).

fields: Any (master's, AFAM, PhD, research, Italian language)
note: MAECI's annual call, separate from Invest Your Talent in Italy. The 2026-27 call came out in mid-March and closed on 26 Mar 2026 at 14:00. The 2027-28 call is expected on a similar schedule.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Indonesia
host: AMINEF (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: Travel, tuition and fees, insurance, monthly maintenance, books, computer
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: AMINEF's Fulbright Master's Degree Scholarship covers travel, tuition and fees, insurance, a monthly allowance, books and a computer for a two-year US master's. Screening runs Mar–May, interviews Jun–Jul, and study starts in the fall of the following year.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Mexico
host: COMEXUS (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: Up to US$37,000 per academic year (master's up to 18 months)
dlText: 15 Jan 2027 (call opened 2 Sep 2026; for study starting Aug 2028; time not stated)
tags: Up to 5 US university applications supported
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: COMEXUS's Fulbright-García Robles graduate grant pays up to US$37,000 per academic year (up to 18 months for a master's) and helps with admission to up to five US universities. The current call is for studies starting in August 2028, and the official page shows some conflicting dates, so confirm on the site.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Türkiye
host: Fulbright Türkiye (Turkish Fulbright Commission) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 10 Apr 2026 (2027-28 round, closed; time not stated)
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: Fulbright Türkiye's master's grant funds up to two academic years in the US, with no upper age limit, starting in fall 2027 for this round. The 2027-28 round closed on 10 Apr 2026; a separate doctoral grant has the same deadline.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Argentina
host: Comisión Fulbright Argentina (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 25 Mar 2026, end of day (2027-28 call, closed)
tags: Master's or PhD in the US
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: Fulbright Argentina's regular master's and doctoral grants for study in the US. The 2027-28 call ran 30 Jan–25 Mar 2026 for programmes starting Aug/Sep 2027, with co-funded variants (Ministerio de Capital Humano, IAPG Houston) on the same deadline.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Colombia
host: Comisión Fulbright Colombia (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 15 May 2026, 23:59 Colombia time (cohort 2027, closed)
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: The J. William Fulbright Program funds a master's in the US for Colombian professionals. The cohort-2027 call closed on 15 May 2026. Applicants needed a bachelor's degree obtained by 31 Dec 2023 and at least one year of professional experience.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Japan
host: Japan-U.S. Educational Commission (Fulbright Japan) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 1 Jul 2026 (postmark; 2027-28 round, closed)
nextText: Next round: registration ~Mar–May 2027, applications ~1 Jul 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle)
tags: Bachelor's by 31 Mar of grant year
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: Fulbright Japan's Graduate Study Program for Japanese citizens living in Japan. For 2027-28, online registration ran 1 Mar–1 May 2026 and applications were due by postmark on 1 Jul 2026, with interview results in November 2026.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – the Philippines
host: Philippine-American Educational Foundation (PAEF) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 30 Apr 2026 (2027-28 round, closed; time not stated)
nominationBody: The Fulbright commission in the Philippines
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: PAEF's Fulbright Foreign Student Program funds master's or doctoral study in the US for Filipino professionals with at least two years of work experience after college. The 2027-28 round closed on 30 Apr 2026; PAEF says the application period usually runs December to March.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Vietnam
host: U.S. Embassy & Consulate in Vietnam (Fulbright Program) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 15 Apr 2026, 17:00 Vietnam time (2027-28 round, closed)
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: The Fulbright Vietnamese Student Program funds a US master's for Vietnamese citizens living in Vietnam with at least two years of post-graduation work experience. English minimums for the last round were TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 110.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Korea
host: Korean-American Educational Commission (Fulbright Korea) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 19 May 2026, 17:00 KST (2027 round, closed)
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: Fulbright Korea's Graduate Student Program funds a two-year US master's or PhD. For fall 2027, applications ran 1 Apr–19 May 2026 with finalists announced 18 Sep 2026; already-admitted applicants must be able to defer to fall 2027.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Bangladesh
host: U.S. Embassy in Bangladesh (Fulbright Program) (US Department of State Fulbright Program)
amount: check official page (Fulbright grants typically cover tuition, living stipend, travel and insurance)
dlText: 11 Jul 2026, 23:59 BST (Bangladesh time; 2027-28 round, closed)
fields: Most fields (some exclusions such as clinical medicine)
note: Funds a one- to two-year US master's starting September 2027, preferring junior faculty and junior to mid-level staff at research bodies, think tanks and NGOs. You can't already hold a foreign (non-Bangladeshi) master's or a US degree.

name: Banach NAWA Programme
host: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
amount: check official page (scholarship for second-cycle studies)
dlText: 8 May 2026, 15:00 CEST, or earlier when a country group hits its application cap (2026 call, closed)
nextText: Next call expected ~Apr–Jun 2027 (2025 closed 27 Jun, 2026 closed 8 May)

eligibility.note: Citizens of the 36 Polish Aid countries listed in the call (Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa, Latin America, e.g. Ukraine, Vietnam, Nigeria).

fields: Any second-cycle programme at Polish universities
note: NAWA funds second-cycle (master's) studies or a preparatory course in Poland for recent graduates from Polish Aid countries. The 2026 call closed on 8 May 2026, or earlier for groups that reached their cap (300 applications each in groups 1–3, 200 in group 4), so apply early. You also need admission from the university.

name: Poland My First Choice NAWA
host: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
amount: PLN 2,000/month + tuition exemption at public universities
dlText: 29 May 2026, 15:00 Warsaw time (2026 call, closed)

eligibility.note: Candidates from countries and territories with a high level of socio-economic development, as listed in the call.

fields: Any full-time second-cycle programme
note: A monthly stipend of PLN 2,000 plus tuition exemption at public universities for a full-time master's in Poland. The 2026 call closed on 29 May 2026 and awarded 25 scholarships from 42 applications. You apply separately for university admission.

name: Estonian National Scholarship for Degree and Exchange Study
host: Estonian Ministry of Education and Research / Education and Youth Board (Harno)
amount: €350/month (master's), €660/month (PhD)
dlText: 31 Oct 2026, 23:59 Estonian time (window 1–31 Oct 2026, closed)

eligibility.note: Citizens of the countries in Annex 1 of the scholarship guide; citizens of Russia and Belarus excluded for 2026/27.

fields: Any master's or doctoral field
note: A small number (15) of monthly stipends for foreign master's and PhD students admitted to an Estonian university. You apply by email with your admission letter, during October. It covers living costs only, not tuition.

name: Lithuanian State Scholarships for Full-Time Master's Studies
host: Education Exchanges Support Foundation (Lithuanian Ministry of Education, Science and Sport)
amount: €592/month (2026) + grant covering study costs up to the national standard
dlText: 20 Apr 2026, 16:00 Vilnius time (2026 call, closed)
nextText: Next call ~spring 2027; country list changes yearly

countryNotes.UA: Ukraine has its own quota of 20 grants.

fields: Any full-time master's at Lithuanian universities
note: A monthly stipend plus coverage of study costs for a full master's in Lithuania. The 2026 call (70 grants) closed on 20 Apr 2026. Foreign citizens of Lithuanian origin from outside the EU/EFTA are also eligible. You apply to the university and to the scholarship separately.

name: Mexican Government Excellence Scholarships for Foreigners (Becas de Excelencia)
host: Mexican Agency for International Development Cooperation (AMEXCID), SRE
amount: ~MXN 14,265/month for master's (4× UMA, 2026); 5× UMA for doctoral/postdoctoral research stays
dlText: 22 Jun 2026, 15:00 central Mexico time (2026 call, closed)

eligibility.note: Foreign nationals of the 170+ countries listed in the call; Mexicans are not eligible.

fields: Master's, doctorate and research stays at about 90 participating Mexican institutions
note: Mexico's annual scholarship for foreigners, paying a monthly stipend tied to the UMA unit, at about 90 institutions with programmes in the national postgraduate system. The 2026 call ran 21 May–22 Jun 2026 through SIGCA. Admission doesn't guarantee a scholarship.

name: República de Chile Master's Scholarships (AGCID)
host: Chilean Agency for International Development Cooperation (AGCID)
amount: check official page
dlText: 30 Oct 2026 final deadline (2027 call, closed); check your country's focal point for its earlier document deadline
nextText: Next call expected ~mid-2027 (estimated from previous calls)

eligibility.note: Nationals of the Latin American and Caribbean countries invited in the call; check the current call text.

fields: Master's programmes at Chilean universities (taught in Spanish)
note: The Chilean government's master's scholarship for Latin American and Caribbean professionals, for studies from 3 Mar 2027 to 28 Feb 2029. You apply through your country's focal point with a final admission letter. The 2027 call's final deadline was 30 Oct 2026.

name: PEC-PG (Programa de Estudantes-Convênio de Pós-Graduação)
host: Government of Brazil (CNPq / Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
amount: R$2,100/month master's (24 months), R$3,100/month doctorate (48 months), plus SUS health access
dlText: Set by each participating Brazilian institution (eligible institutions announced Nov–Dec 2026; scholarships start Mar 2027–Mar 2028)
tags: Must live in a participating country

eligibility.note: Nationals of the developing countries with education agreements with Brazil, who live in a participating country; Brazilian nationals excluded.

fields: Any field at participating Brazilian graduate programmes
note: Under CNPq Call 16/2026, Brazilian institutions select foreign master's and doctoral students for up to 100 + 100 scholarships. Once CNPq publishes the list of eligible institutions (Nov–Dec 2026), contact those programmes for their deadlines.
